svg.title: UI Screen 04: Calculator
svg.desc: Calculator Workbench mockup: Scientific, Convert, Percent and Dates tabs, a pinned result with a Copy button, and a shared history tape.
svg.text: Scientific, unit and currency, percentage and tax, and date math in one place.
Numbers are white, operators blue, functions grey, clear and delete red, and = is the large orange key.
UI Screen 04: Calculator · desktop, Scientific tab · result pinned at top, shared history tape on the right
